title: FA3 vendor-neutral model-agnostic 1..N CPU/accelerator hardware portability baseline
accepted: minimum one CPU package and at least eight physical cores per qualifying CPU
one or more CPU packages discovered dynamically
minimum one qualifying accelerator with no global vendor or runtime API requirement
NVIDIA AMD and Intel accelerators are supported through provider/workload capability negotiation
NVIDIA DGX is a supported platform family and is not a separate architectural authority
CUDA compute capability ROCm architecture and Level Zero/oneAPI requirements are provider/workload-scoped rather than global hardware-floor requirements
one or more qualifying accelerators discovered dynamically
live CPU core SMT cpuset NUMA memory PCIe accelerator driver and runtime capability discovery
admission and placement through the existing Host Resource Broker
exact current-host topology retained only as evidence or reference deployment data
rejected_as_canonical_hardware_requireme: fixed CPU package or socket count above the minimum
static CPU ID lists or NUMA node IDs
global CUDA ROCm Level Zero oneAPI or other runtime API requirement
global vendor-specific architecture or compute-capability floor
fixed accelerator count above the minimum
fixed VRAM size or architecture name as the platform baseline
fixed runtime ordinal or visible-device list
specific workstation server or DGX model

supersedence.rule: Any earlier FA3 text or configuration that treats an exact CPU model, socket count, CPU list, NUMA node, accelerator vendor/SKU/count, vendor runtime API/capability floor, PCI address or runtime ordinal as a portable canonical requirement is superseded by this decision.
